boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 58 is a funnel board with three wide cyan bays, a smaller throat marked `4`, and a cluttered upper deck balancing a purple `6` chamber against a framed blue block on the right. Open the right shoulder first, trim the left `6` chamber second, and only then let the red and green center strips drop into the cyan funnel.
landmarks: Block Out Level 58 is a funnel board with three wide cyan bays, a smaller throat marked `4`, and a cluttered upper deck balancing a purple `6` chamber against a framed blue block on the right.
Open the right shoulder first, trim the left `6` chamber second, and only then let the red and green center strips drop into the cyan funnel.
The board mixes Purple, Blue, Orange and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: If the framed blue block is still hanging over the right shoulder, the funnel is not ready.
Open both shoulders before you let the red center strip drop into the cyan bays.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the framed blue block in the upper-right corner so the right shoulder starts opening.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shorten the skinny cyan `2` counters on that same side before you touch the middle too hard.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Start reducing the purple `6` chamber on the left once the right shoulder is lighter.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Let the red center strip and nearby green pieces fall into the three wide cyan bays only after both shoulders are open.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Collapse the lower `4` throat once the top deck has stopped feeding extra blockers into it.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the last red vertical piece and the surviving shoulder blocks after the funnel is mostly empty.

failurePoints: Trying to fill the cyan bays while the framed blue block still hangs over the right shoulder.
Dropping the red center strip before the left `6` chamber and right `2` counters have both shortened.
